feature: RIP Hirer/Driver Furnished Report (layar report, export xlsx, dan job harian yang mengirim email ke OIC)
story: OCMS14.x (belum dipastikan, di luar chunk OCMS14.11-14.15)
note: Report notice PS-RP2 dengan offender hirer/driver yang deceased dan alamat furnished, lengkap dengan layar, export xlsx dari backend, dan job harian jam 08:00 (cron.dailyreport enabled=true) yang email ke OIC. Bukan report ownership DOS yang diminta OCMS14.12-14.14. Kemungkinan milik story lain di epic 14; belum dipastikan dan tidak diklaim di chunk ini.
note_en: A report of PS-RP2 notices whose offender is a deceased hirer/driver with a furnished address, with a screen, a backend xlsx export and a daily 08:00 job (cron.dailyreport enabled=true) that emails the OIC. It is not the DOS ownership report asked for by OCMS14.12-14.14. It may belong to another epic 14 story; not confirmed and not claimed in this chunk.

feature: Layar DOS Reports (daftar query kepemilikan kendaraan) tanpa backend
note: UI memanggil resource dosvaultrecords dan menampilkan Query Type 'Vehicle Ownership' untuk stage NPA, tetapi tidak ada controller dosvaultrecords di ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi dan tidak ada mapping OCMS_REPORT_DOS di api-authorization.properties. Sisa UI lama; tidak diklaim sebagai pengambilan kepemilikan DOS.
note_en: The UI calls the dosvaultrecords resource and shows Query Type 'Vehicle Ownership' for stage NPA, but there is no dosvaultrecords controller in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or thirdpartyapi and no OCMS_REPORT_DOS mapping in api-authorization.properties. Leftover older UI; not claimed as a DOS ownership fetch.
